test_title: PYST 13: RRB Group D - GA (Held On: 03 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which among the following authorities invoked Stage-I of the Graded Response Action Plan (GRAP) in May 2025 due to poor air quality in Delhi NCR?

options.text: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (MoHFW)
Delhi Pollution Control Committee (DPCC), National Capital Territory of Delhi
Commission for Air Quality Management in National Capital Region and Adjoining Areas (CAQM)

solution: The correct answer is __**Commission for Air Quality Management in National Capital Region and Adjoining Areas (CAQM)**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • The **Commission for Air Quality Management in National Capital Region and Adjoining Areas (CAQM)** invoked **Stage-I of the Graded Response Action Plan (GRAP)** in May 2025 in response to deteriorating air quality in Delhi NCR. • **GRAP** is a set of measures designed to combat air pollution in a graded manner based on the Air Quality Index (AQI) levels, ranging from moderate to severe plus (emergency) conditions. • The CAQM was established under the **Commission for Air Quality Management in National Capital Region and Adjoining Areas Act, 2021**, and is responsible for tackling air pollution in Delhi NCR and its adjoining areas. • The commission is empowered to enforce measures to reduce pollution, coordinate between states, and ensure compliance with pollution control laws. • Stage-I of GRAP is triggered when the AQI falls into the "poor" category (AQI between 201-300) and includes measures such as banning diesel generator sets, increasing public transport, and ensuring proper waste disposal.
